topic: Debugging data granularity and date range
summary_markdown: The production environment was fixed by rolling back the infrastructure. However, a problem remains on the staging and beta environments. To troubleshoot data visibility issues, someone was advised to set the date range in the calendar from November 1st to January 10th, specifically noting that granular data for three days in January is present but difficult to see.
decisions: The production environment infrastructure issue was resolved via rollback.
action_items: Review the calendar period using a date range from November 1st to January 10th on staging/beta environments.
